extracted.name: Kofta in tahini sauce
extracted.description: This recipe you could change the tahini sauce with tomato sauce
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 lb ground lamb and beef mix
1 teaspoon each paprika,all spice, turmeric, salt, pepper, garlic powder onion powder, hot chili pepper
instruction_lines: Wash potato and peeled slice thick chopped onion add 1/2 teaspoon of salt pepper and 1 teaspoon of all spice and 2 tablespoon olive oil mix all Cook at 400 f for 20 minutes
Mix the meat with chopped onion and parsley all the spices roll them and top them on the cooked potato and one cup of broth Cook in the oven for 25 minutes
Start on sauce mix every thing adding the hot water slowly so it will not lump I add garlic to mine it’s optional
Take all juice of the cooked meat the tray from oven and add to the tahini sauce whisk and add it back to the tray and cook for 15 minute and 5 minutes under the broiler
You serve it with rice or pita bread enjoy 😉
